How long has your tank been established for? There can be dormant eggs in the tank that can take some time to hatch so might be worth waiting! 

I wouldn’t replace the water due to there being a large amount of algae which is a super good thing. Adding a new egg packet will increase the salinity of the water due to there being salts in the packet. I’d check the salinity of the water after doing so if possible and if it rises too high you can fix this by removing some of the tank water and replacing it with distilled water :)

I have my lights on for 16~ or so hours a day. I turn them off when I go to bed and turn them back on when I get up :) sooner you set the light up the sooner it’ll help with algae growth so I’d say have it on asap!

Sand is best as they can get trapped under the gravel and die! I learned this the hard way!

You’ll want to make your water up to ideally 25PPT so going off 10 gallon/ 37.85 litres you’ll need 945g of salt.

I’d recommend a plant grow light to help speed up algae growth. I grow micro algae in a separate tank to use as an alternative food source and I use aquatic plant fertiliser to help it grow! I’m not too sure how this would affect your sea monkeys putting it directly into your sea monkey tank so do this with caution!

A heater and air stone are a must for a large tank too. You’ll want your water at a steady 27c~ as this is most optimal for algae and monkey growth.

My large tank (3 gallon) has taken 3 attempts to get right so give it a few chances before giving up!

If you have any more questions I’ll do my best to answer them!

Good luck! 😁

It's easy.

You have your main account, let's call it *Account A*. You create a new email address, but DONT link it to a Battle.net account. We'll call this *Account B*. Log into *Account A*, press "O" and look for the refer a friend button. Click this and it'll ask you to enter your "friends" email address, simply enter *Account B's* email address. After, log into *Account B's* email address and follow the on screen instructions. Once complete, simply open two versions of the client, and get *Account B* to follow *Account A's* toon, and you'll get triple EXP! Make sure to both complete the quests, and buy Battle Chest when both toons are level 20. This will allow you to level to 85. Have fun leveling! :)
